INFO:

Spoiler

vanilla starsector has total of 50 ability slots, spread across 5 toolbars... this mod allows you to use ALL of them, at the same time!
also features cached inputs, so if you, for example, press "4" and "3" on keyboard within 0.5s of each other, it will activate ability in slot 43
beyond that, should work the same as normal and make no changes to the actual functionality of abilities.

aiDescription: Enables access to all 50 vanilla ability slots at once instead of spreading them across five separate toolbars. Includes cached input detection so pressing two number keys quickly activates a combined slot, such as 43 for keys 4 and 3. Otherwise functions identically to standard abilities without altering their behavior.
